cohort: 150 pregnant women with one previous cesarean section fulfilling the criteria for undergoing trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: A new VBAC prediction model, incorporating maternal age, gestational age, Bishop's score, body mass index, indication for primary cesarean section, and fetal weight, demonstrated good predictive ability for successful VBAC (area under the curve of 0.77).
mod_finding: The study found that the proposed VBAC prediction model can be used to counsel women regarding the mode of delivery in current and subsequent pregnancies.
